summary: Setting "spectatorsGenerateChunks" to false and relogging freezes the game on the Loading Terrain screen
description: This is bad. I was trying to spectate my hardcore world after dying, but got stuck in unloaded chunks at my respawn point. Due to this gamerule being set to false when you die in hardcore, I thought to exit out of the world, turn on cheats, and force the chunks around me to load. Because I couldn t load any chunks, my hardcore world cannot load, thus freezing the game at the "loading terrain" screen, which softlocks the game. How to reproduce - Die in hardcore. Make sure your death point and spawnpoint are far away from each other. - If you get trapped in unloaded chunks, relog from the world. If not, open the world to LAN amd try again. - Try to open the world. - Sit in your chair for the rest of forever waiting for your world to load.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Hardcore world with default settings.
2. Ensure your death point and spawnpoint are far away from each other.
3. Die within the Hardcore world to set `spectatorsGenerateChunks` to false automatically.
4. Attempt to relog out of the world.
5. Try to open the world again after relogging.
6. Observe that the game freezes on the "Loading Terrain" screen and does not progress further, effectively softlocking the game.
7. Note the coordinates or location where you are stuck if applicable.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.18.2, 22w11a, 22w12a, 22w13a, 1.19 Pre-release 3, 1.19 Pre-release 5, 1.19, 1.19.1 Pre-release 4, 1.19.2 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When setting the "spectatorsGenerateChunks" gamerule to false and attempting to relog after dying in a hardcore world, the game freezes on the "Loading Terrain" screen, effectively softlocking the player. This issue occurs because the gamerule prevents chunk generation for spectators, leading to an inability to load any chunks around the respawn point if it is far from the death location. As a result, the game gets stuck at the loading screen indefinitely, preventing further progress or interaction with the world. To reproduce this bug, first die in hardcore mode and ensure that your death point and spawnpoint are significantly distant from each other. If you get trapped in unloaded chunks upon relogging, the issue will manifest, freezing the game on the "Loading Terrain" screen. Alternatively, opening the world to LAN and attempting to load it again can also trigger this behavior, resulting in an endless wait for chunk loading to complete.
Expected Behavior: When "spectatorsGenerateChunks" is set to false and you relog after dying in a hardcore world, the game should load the chunks around your spawn point without freezing on the Loading Terrain screen. You should be able to spectate the world normally without getting stuck in unloaded chunks. The game should not softlock, allowing you to navigate and interact with the environment as expected.
